heading: Funding
lead: In addition to any other funds made available by this chapter, of the funds of the Commodity Credit Corporation, the Secretary shall make available to carry out this chapter $150,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 and each fiscal year thereafter, to remain available until expended.

notes.text: Amendments2025—Pub. L. 119–21 substituted “$150,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 and each fiscal year thereafter, to remain available until expended” for “$50,000,000 for fiscal year 2019 and each fiscal year thereafter”.
